named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcct
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status FROM esq_account WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND acc_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcctForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status FROM esq_account WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND acc_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FOR UPDATE

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.updateAcct
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_account SET acc_desc = :desc ,acc_status = :status ,acc_crl_id = :correlationId ,acc_req_id = :requestId ,acc_uid = :uid WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)
